title: Smoothing the Score Function to Enhance Generalization in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.19285v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models achieve remarkable generation quality, yet face a fundamental challenge known as memorization, where generated samples can replicate training samples exactly. We develop a theoretical framework to explain this phenomenon by showing that the empirical score function (the score function corresponding to the empirical distribution) is a weighted sum of the score functions of Gaussian distributions, in which the weights are sharp softmax functions. This structure causes individual training samples to dominate the score function, resulting in sampling collapse. In practice, approximating the empirical score function with a neural network can partially alleviate this issue and improve generalization. Our theoretical framework explains why: In training, the neural network learns a smoother approximation of the weighted sum, allowing the sampling process to be influenced by local manifolds rather than single points. Leveragi

translated_title: 平滑得分函数以增强扩散模型的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 扩散模型实现了卓越的生成质量，但面临一个被称为“记忆化”的根本性挑战，即生成的样本可能会完全复制训练样本。我们开发了一个理论框架来解释这一现象，证明经验得分函数（对应经验分布的得分函数）是多个高斯分布得分函数的加权和，其中权重为尖锐的softmax函数。这种结构导致单个训练样本主导得分函数，从而造成采样坍缩。在实践中，用神经网络近似经验得分函数可以部分缓解这一问题并改善泛化能力。我们的理论框架解释了其原因：在训练过程中，神经网络学习到该加权和的更平滑近似，使采样过程受到局部流形而非单个点的影响。
tldr: 本文建立理论框架解释扩散模型的记忆化现象，证明经验得分函数是权重为尖锐softmax函数的高斯得分函数加权和从而导致采样坍缩，并揭示神经网络学习更平滑的近似可使采样受局部流形而非单点影响，从而增强泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theoretical framework explaining memorization in diffusion models, showing that the empirical score function is a weighted sum of Gaussian score functions with sharp softmax weights causing sampling collapse, and reveals that neural networks learn smoother approximations so that sampling is influenced by local manifolds rather than single points, thereby enhancing generalization.
